outcome: Protocol 11: a local-only mode keeps .inkan/ on this checkout and does not commit it
criteria: inkan init writes a protocol 11 block; the default (repo) block still says to commit the outcome record with the work and to commit .inkan/ with the code; init --local writes a local-only block that says to keep .inkan/ on this checkout only, not to commit it, and not to include an Inkan-Outcome trailer

init upgrades generated blocks of protocols 1 through 10 in place to protocol 11 repo mode, upgrades a generated local-only block in place, still refuses a hand-edited block, and refuses --local together with --repo
this repository's AGENTS.md is the rendered protocol 11 repo-mode block
both READMEs mention local-only mode and decision 0008 carries a history entry for protocol 11

reason: Decision 0018 is the constraint this work is bound by: local-only is an explicit init mode, not a silent reinterpretation of the commit-with-the-code default.

note: Protocol 11 adds <!-- inkan-mode: repo --> and <!-- inkan-mode: local -->. Default init still writes the repo block (commit the record, include the trailer, commit .inkan/ with the code). init --local writes the local-only block (keep .inkan/ on this checkout, do not commit it, do not include an Inkan-Outcome trailer). A bare init keeps the current mode; --repo switches back; --local with --repo is refused. V1 through V10 stay verbatim; init upgrades them to protocol 11 repo mode and upgrades a generated local block in place. This repository's AGENTS.md is the protocol 11 repo block (second init reports no change). Both READMEs mention local-only; decision 0018 records the choice; 0008 has a protocol 11 history entry. 114 unit tests pass.
